title: C24/9/2021 of MANJU BISHT Vs NARENDRA SINGH BISHT

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C24 No.09 of 2021
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Through Hybrid Mode)
Mr. Suresh Chandra Bhatt, Advocate for
the applicant.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the
respondents.
The applicant to the present Transfer
Application, which has been filed under Section
24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, is a defendant
in a proceeding, which has been instituted by
respondent-husband by invoking the provisions
contained under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage
Act, which has been registered as Original Suit
No.26 of 2021, Narendra Singh Bisht vs. Smt.
Manju Bisht, which is presently pending
consideration before the learned Judge, Family
Court, Vikas Nagar, District Dehradun.
The contention of the counsel for the
applicant to the present Transfer Application, is
that since she is working as an Assistant Teacher
in Government Primary School Saindark, District
Champawat, coupled with the fact that the
respondent-husband is working in the Indian
Bank at Roorkee, District Haridwar, the
institution of the proceedings of the suit at Vikas
Nagar was malicious with just an intention to
harass the applicant.
Be that as it may.
This Court is not venturing on that
controversy, but on balancing the equities and
convenience of both the parties to the proceedings
under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act,
which is a social legislation, coupled with the fact
that in principal the parties to the Transfer
Application, have not also principally agreed the
offer extended by the Court, that the matter may

be transferred to the competent Family Court at
Rudrapur.
This Transfer Application is allowed and as
a consequence thereto, the Matrimonial Suit
No.26 of 2021 Narendra Singh Bisht vs. Smt.
Manju Bisht, pending before the Judge, Family
Court, Vikas Nagar, District Dehradun, is directed
to be transferred to the court of competent
jurisdiction i.e. the Court of Family Court,
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
It is further made clear that as soon as the
matter is transferred to the Family Court,
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar, it would
be the responsibility of the court to issue notice to
the parties.
Subject to the aforesaid, the Transfer
Application stands disposed of.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 04.08.2021
